license: All rights reserved; no reuse license granted by this release
purpose: Public reference implementation for evidence-native verification, validation, reproducibility, traceability, and mission assurance.
public_boundary: Software, schemas, synthetic fixtures, and public documentation only; no real program evidence or sensitive operational data.
does: validate assurance-graph structure and selected semantics
list unresolved assumptions without automated priority scoring
expose direct evidence gaps on critical nodes
show dependency impact through declared depends_on/requires relations
verify declared code and input artifact hashes plus versioned output acceptance and numerical checks

explicitly reproduce trusted version-2 receipts and local version-3 receipts in a fresh declared-artifact workspace with SHA-256-bound code, direct declared-entrypoint execution, and freshly generated outputs
verify version-3 stochastic or hybrid output acceptance without discarding observed output hashes
validate version-3 calibration/instrument-state provenance and declared validity windows
verify synthetic external-job submission and collection provenance without claiming to run a real scheduler in public CI
verify that decision-receipt basis references exist in a valid graph
validate portable scientific-discovery assurance contracts and their synthetic cross-record references
keep formal proof-checker state separate from specification-equivalence state
preserve explicit research-priority, research-boundary, attribution, and replication states
connect consequential decisions to explicit reopen conditions through Mission Decision Packets
publish stable identifiers for versioned portable contracts
does_not: authorize safety, security, acquisition, compliance, or mission readiness
serve as a public storage location for real program evidence
provide a sandbox or hermetic execution environment for reproduction
launch external scheduler or cluster jobs
establish trusted scientific priority from a local clock value alone
prove enforcement of a declared research-data boundary
treat proof-checker success as automatic specification validation
claim authorship or signer identity for unsigned core receipts
distribution: GitHub source and release workflow; public package-index upload intentionally blocked by package metadata.
evidence_lifecycle: Source-controlled validation defines deterministic expectations; commit-specific hosted proof belongs to GitHub Actions and tagged release metadata.
interoperability: Versioned core schemas use stable identifiers. Richer domain records may map into FMA contracts without collapsing local evidence, calibration, acceptance, or decision semantics.
maintenance: Keep main as the protected long-lived branch, use immutable GitHub Action pins, dependency review, protected-main CodeQL, bounded dependency updates, and full V&V after material source changes.
